label: Fix shutdown-complete ordering and listener leak in claim-verification
summary: Fixed two bugs in claim-verification worker shutdown: (1) verifierWorker.ts swapped close/postMessage order so shutdownComplete is not silently dropped, (2) worker.ts changed worker.on to worker.once to prevent listener leak

changes.kind: moved parentPort!.postMessage before parentPort!.close() in shutdown handler
changed worker.on('message', ...) to worker.once('message', ...) in shutdown() to prevent listener leak
